source_routing_notes: Each emitted-event opportunity owns at most one committing live phase; boundary/perform can add one PRECALL. Exceptions choose one return/failure branch, never both.
Each depth-zero assertion can call operand on at most two non-msg slots; raises/raisesRegex skip the list. Every attempted prepare counts even if no new binding is published.
The addsub patch adds one phase before the existing result callback. Z=L-3 counts subtest callbacks separately from root lifecycle.
Raw recv/message and join/exit do not emit their own events, so use the source M/X primitives, not emitted-event counts.
Parent started executes even when selected is false or preview is None; count every source process opportunity P. Pipe/preview/bind mutate only in DI07, each once.
Pipe and BaseProcess.start selected are pure-proxy snapshots even when false. P=H+DI07 overcounts launches because H also counts receive/finish; it safely covers one Pipe/start per launch.

Within the pinned33-module graph, all actual BaseProcess/Pipe sites route via T/R start, Drive spawn or direct DI07. Noncausal unit parallelism uses threading.Thread and does not enter BaseProcess.start. No original methods are run to obtain the census.
Setup/discovery/cleanup paths retain the inherited source review; no hidden second Recorder or repeated finish. Cleanup joins are in X. Header/page work is inside its owning draft.

lifetime_routes.retention: Until _atomic returns; private metadata may escape only as returned substructure. Count whole batch even after return.
draft, _memo and writes survive unlocked IO; no assumption of immediate deallocation.
Return may escape and remain referenced by callers/finish sidecar; count all snapshots through end.
Traceback/frame/failed-draft bound methods can retain cycles until GC. This is a subset of F opportunities, not F additional batches.
One source state graph in addition to every batch, intentionally overcounting published aliases.

lifetime_envelope.normal_and_rejected_fork_storage: A partial/rejected clone is charged as a full batch. Metadata operations and original error control flow still require the inherited shape/source-route scope; this is not an arbitrary-allocation-failure RSS theorem.

kernel_work.unit: logical operation opportunities, not CPU seconds
